verdict.rationale: Highnote lets you define declarative spend rules and velocity controls, on MCC, amount, authorization count and time windows, that run automatically at authorization and permit or restrict transactions. Rules can be set once at the program level and apply to every card. Beyond authorization decisions, event-driven actions depend on configurable webhooks or collaborative authorization calling your own business logic, so there is no general-purpose event→action rules engine. Missing for 10: native rules triggering arbitrary actions on non-authorization events, a no-code automation builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
